item.title: News Flow — 2026-09-10
item.description: Bugünün öne çıkan haberleri: Trump administration proposes waiving grace period for H-1B holders after job loss; Trump promises $500 Obamacare rebate checks for 1M enrollees in 30 states; Zelenskyy visits Canada to seek further military support for Ukraine; Trump administration silence has 200,000 Salvadoran immigrants hoping they’re protected; US producer prices increase as expected in August; but key details firmer; White House copper tariff plan stalls amid affordability concerns, sources say
